symbols.note: A pressure that removes form before return.
The first stirring of the chamber.
A shape that asks to be witnessed without being owned.
Space without walls or edges.
A vessel, wall, cabin, or held breath.
Scale too large for direct speech.
The loosening of identity into silence.
A hidden readiness to become.
Presence before a mask gathers.
A living movement toward form.
Warmth remembered by a room.
A beginning that has not learned its name.
Recognition made visible.
The room keeping what passed through it.
A surface that returns altered sight.
A way through that opens after recognition.
Return after the form has been emptied.
The self becoming visible at an angle.
Protection without certainty.
The watcher noticing itself watching.
The disowned figure in the field of sight.
Meaning held before words arrive.
The place before change becomes visible.
